summary: SETUPRACE-1 recoverable atomic claim, whole-branch Codex autoreview looped to convergence. The claim/confirm/clear is correctly fenced by an ownership token (a stale claimant cannot clear a successor's claim); the pending-claim-vs-delivery interaction is handled (delivery view clears notified_fingerprint; the prompt does not gate on it); a prior 'prompt suppression' finding was verified as a false positive and closed with a faithful test. The one standing finding — a duplicate card is possible across a post-send crash or a delivery that hangs past the TTL — is an ACCEPTED fundamental limit (exactly-once over a hangable channel needs a durable idempotent outbox; disproportionate for a setup card), ratified by Ravi and documented in 0117 + code.

non_blocking_findings.summary: At-least-once across a post-send crash and a >TTL hung delivery (rare duplicate card, never lost). Accepted fundamental limit; documented.

residual_risks: At-least-once delivery across the two abnormal windows above (accepted).
recommendation: Land; the at-least-once ceiling is documented and accepted.
